worked: Federal AGI = wages 261,500.00 = 261,500.00. Federal taxable income = 261,500.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction = 230,000.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 261,500.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 0.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 261,500.00 + (0.00) = 261,500.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 261,500.00 - 254,250.00 = 7,250.00, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 7,250.00 / 7,250 = 1.0000000, a whole number 1; line 7 = 0.8000. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly) x 0.8000 = 17,440.00. Line 5 = 261,500.00 - 17,440.00 = 244,060.00. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00 x 0.8000 = 8,160.00. Line 7 taxable income = 244,060.00 - 8,160.00 = 235,900.00. Line 8 tax on 235,900.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 54,250.00 x 0.0599 = 3249.575000 = 11,078.95. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 11,078.95. Note: Exactly one 7,250 band over: 7,250 / 7,250 = 1 exactly, so this stays in the first band at 0.8000.
